title: Collect a scheduled Pix-out signature notification
description: Event generated when the Schedule transfer(s) V2 endpoint is called to create a scheduler and the execution of the pix-out scheduled occurs. For more information, see the Pix-instant payments guide. Also see the Pix payments data events guide.

scheduler_id.title: Scheduler Identifier
scheduler_id.description: Scheduler ID created upon scheduling a collection of pix out transfers

execution_id.title: Scheduler Execution Identifier
execution_id.description: Execution ID of a specific scheduled pix out transfer

psp_transaction_created_at.title: Transaction datetime
psp_transaction_created_at.description: Date/time of the signature. A RFC 3339 Nano date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52.000Z'.

idempotency_key.title: Unique ID to ensure idempotency
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique transaction ID. This value cannot be repeated.

end_to_end_id.title: Pix end to end ID
end_to_end_id.description: Pix end to end transaction ID. This field is a Brazil Central Bank (BCB) requirement to track Pix transactions. Basically, there are two steps to a Pix transaction: 1. Initialize a transaction and 2. Confirm a transaction. This field is sent to the BCB in both steps in order to identify all transaction information.

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: Payee's bank code - ISPB (Identificador do Sistema de Pagamento Brazil) - the Brazilian Payment System identifier, an 8-digit value.

document_number.title: Payee's document number
document_number.description: Payee ID. A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil). Must be numeric with 11-14 digits.

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: Payer's bank code - ISPB (Identificador do Sistema de Pagamento Brazil) - the Brazilian Payment System identifier, an 8-digit value.

document_number.title: Payer's document number
document_number.description: Payer ID. A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil). Must be numeric with 11-14 digits.

transaction_identification.title: Transaction identification code
transaction_identification.description: Transaction Identifier of the pix out transfer.

recurrence_id.title: Recurrence Pix Identifier
recurrence_id.description: Recurrence Identifier of the Recurrence Pix

data_to_be_signed.title: Data to be signed
data_to_be_signed.description: The buffer with the data to be signed by the requester. The format depends on the Provider and this is a suggestion of input for the signature process
